subject: Exec workshop: handoff pickup lane and rideshare ops for Acme on 2027-04-27

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: ops@shuttlelane.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: pickup lane handoff + rideshare dispatch for Acme workshop (4/27)

Hi Samir / ShuttleLane team —

We're running an on-site enterprise workshop for Acme on Tuesday 4/27 (8:30am — 5:00pm) at our Mission Bay campus. Expected headcount: 48 attendees + 6 executive guests who will require dedicated car services. A few quick asks to confirm feasibility and initial pricing: 

- Can you run a dedicated pickup lane/staging area in Lot B (north entrance) and provide on-demand car service for the execs?
- We need rideshare pickup points integrated with our on-site dispatch so drivers receive a manifest and signage (example signage names in attached map).
- Accessibility: 12 attendees require accessible vehicles (ramps/assist).
- Parking passes: we will need 8 short-term visitor passes for vendor cars (drop-off/pick-up).

Attached: site_map_parking_B_v3.pdf (shows curb, parking, and proposed staging). I've also attached a redacted attendee manifest for routing.

On-site contact: Neha Kapoor (mobile: +1-415-555-0199) and Vivek Kulkarni (ops lead) will manage check-ins. Can you confirm your SLA for on-site response time, driver check-in process (placards/badging), and a ballpark estimate for: 
  - Dedicated car service for 6 exec round trips (airport shuttles + point-to-point)
  - Per-pickup fee for ad-hoc rideshare hails routed via your dispatch

Would like a proposal by EOD Monday 4/5 so we can finalize procurement.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Manager, Events & Field Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: site_map_parking_B_v3.pdf, attendee_manifest_redacted.csv

From: Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@acme.com> (on behalf of ShuttleLane Ops <ops@shuttlelane.com>)

Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: pickup lane handoff + rideshare dispatch for Acme workshop (4/27)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear brief and the site map. ShuttleLane can support a dedicated staging lane in Lot B and provide on-demand rideshare dispatch integration. A few clarifying Qs before we firm pricing: 

1) For the 6 execs: are those round-trip airport transfers (SFO <-> venue) or mixed point-to-point?
2) Preferred check-in window for arrivals? Do you want drivers to stage 15/30/45 minutes ahead?
3) Billing: do you want ShuttleLane to bill Acme directly, or do we bill Redwood and route cost center info?

High-level pricing (ballpark until we confirm above):
- Dedicated car service (6 exec round-trips SFO): $1,050 per round-trip vehicle (includes meet-and-greet, luggage handling)
- On-demand rideshare handoffs: $12 per pickup managed through our dispatch (plus any ride fare)
- Accessible vehicle surcharge: $25 per trip to cover ramp-equipped vehicle scheduling

SLA / operational notes:
- On-site response: base crew on-site 7:30am–5:30pm; emergency pager response within 10 minutes
- Driver check-in: drivers report to Lot B staging tent, they receive a laminated placard and will be escorted to curb by event staff.
- Integration: we can accept a CSV manifest upload and push to drivers via our mobile dispatcher; we also support a lightweight webhook for ride-state updates (we'll send integration spec once scope confirmed).

I attached a preliminary quote (shuttlelane_quote_0427.pdf) and our rideshare integration spec. If you confirm the airport vs point-to-point split and billing, we'll produce a final SOW and DocuSign-ready quote.

Regards,
Samir Qureshi
Program Ops (ShuttleLane)

Attachments: shuttlelane_quote_0427.pdf, rideshare_integration_spec.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Hi Samir —

Thanks — quick answers to your questions: 
- Exec trips: 4 of the execs are arriving SFO (round-trip needed), 2 are local and will need point-to-point between the hotel and venue (single day).
- Please stage drivers 30 minutes prior to the first scheduled arrival window (first flight arrives ~8:10am; we expect guest arrival through 9:15am).
- Billing: Redwood will be billed; please route invoice to accounts-payable@redwood.com and cc me (we'll forward cost center info).

Also: security requires driver names and license numbers 48 hours prior to the event for gate badges — can ShuttleLane provide that? For accessible vehicles, please prioritize scheduling to avoid long waits; we have 12 attendees flagged.

Next steps: Samir, can you send a final SOW + DocuSign link by EOD today (4/5)? We need procurement sign-off.
